paragraphs: I'm Syed Wajeeh, a multidisciplinary designer with professional experience across product design, UI/UX, branding and digital products.
My approach combines visual clarity, user-centred thinking and an understanding of how digital products actually work.
Alongside my design practice, I'm exploring AI-assisted application development, using tools such as Claude to turn ideas into functional products and prototypes.
I enjoy working with people who want to build useful products, improve existing experiences, or bring a new idea to life.
